links.outcome: Readability and understandability of chatbot keratorefractive surgery answers for patients
links.effect: PEMAT-U: ChatGPT-3.5 68.5%, Bard 78.6%, Bing Chat 67.1%; PEMAT-A 62.6%, 72.4%, 60.9%. Understandability and readability scores were more challenging than the recommended level.
links.quote: Two readability analyses showed that Bing had the highest readability, followed by the ChatGPT-3.5 and Bard, however, the understandability and readability scores were more challenging than the recommended level.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Bard, Bing) on accuracy, understandability, and readability for keratorefractive surgery patient FAQs using expert ratings and standard metrics without testing a specific deployment safeguard.
